title: Publish Temper with its canonical CLI product identity
description: Temper declared the generic SwiftPM executable product `temper`, so Vaporize correctly rejected it at the production build boundary. Rename the product to the canonical advanced CLI identity, update source-run documentation, and preserve the existing i18n findings as a ratcheted baseline with generated remediation records.
acceptanceCriteria: Package.swift declares `temper.cli@swift-universal.clia.sh` as the executable product.
Source-run documentation uses the canonical product name.
Vaporize builds, installs, and verifies the canonical executable on Windows.
Existing i18n findings are represented by generated beads, bindings, evidence, receipts, and a baseline that still rejects new drift.
